summary: Retested /grid after 6 changes. All 6 pass end-to-end via live-DOM Playwright checks (no cached-screenshot reliance). Two color pickers replace old palette buttons; swap works; setting color2 recolours the stage. One image = exactly one rectangle (imgs 0->1->2 after two uploads) and text cells (303/MTL/PLUGIN/meta) persist. Image uses SVG duotone filter url(#duoA|#duoB) and stays visible after toggling grid-invert-toggle (no white-out). 9MB upload => warning toast 'Clip pesante caricata (9.0MB)' AND clip added; 41MB upload => error toast 'troppo pesante (41.0MB, max 40MB) - saltato' AND clip NOT added. Random invert during Play: over 30 Space-triggered cuts with flipOnCut ON, 20 consecutive-same invert pairs observed => confirmed random (not every-cycle alternation). Text span carries className 'vj-fade' and @keyframes vjFade exists in stylesheet. grid-play-button not disabled when mic off. No console errors during flow.
critical_code_review_comments: GridStudio.jsx onFiles: heavy toast only reports the first heavy file's size (heavy[0]); if multiple heavy clips uploaded at once only one is warned. Minor.
GridStudio.jsx cut(): random flip probability hardcoded at 0.35 - fine but could be exposed as a config value later.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 changes verified; 21/21 real checks after false-negative test-logic reconciled)
